The '''Stic system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stic/Legends|Stic]].
